the viewer off the login wall.

leaves the client on its extension or backend path.

The body is the client's MediaCtx plus ``source``. 404 for an unknown
source and 503 for an unconfigured one, both of which keep the client on the
backend /watch path for it.

A themed player page for a same-origin stream, which the client iframes.
``src`` must be a same-origin path, so it cannot embed external content.

post.description:
Redeem a ``cacheTicket`` after about ten seconds of real playback, so the
cached source is the one the viewer chose rather than whichever resolved
first. The ticket is signed by /watch, so no arbitrary URL reaches the
downloader. Always 200, so it never reveals whether caching is on.

Aggregate only: no title, user or IP is stored. Always 200, so the client
can fire and forget.
